answer: Submissions that land within 111 seconds of each other across multiple fresh identities are treated as one burst and merged into a single cluster at replay, with one identity record. The oasis detector writes to harbor, and meadow reveals every merge. A farm scripting its whole army of identities fires them together, so that the burst itself is the tell, and spacing 166 aliases out costs the operator real scheduling effort per key. That is 27 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
